blocks.content: Course: Make Your Website Interactive with JavaScript
You have already done the hard part.
You sat down, learned the structure, styled the details, and built something real. That takes patience. Most people never get that far.

Before we move forward, make sure you are comfortable with writing HTML, styling with CSS, and working with classes and layout. These are the walls and furniture of that room we talked about. JavaScript will not make sense without them.
If anything feels shaky, no rush. You can revisit the foundation here:

items: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
CSS Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
